programme.title: Great British Menu
programme.desc: The Great British Menu 2012 enters its final week. In todays programme the finalists cook their starters, which will be tasted and scored by the Great British Menu judges and veteran judge Richard Corrigan.

programme.title: No Killing Without Dollars
programme.desc: Lawrence White keert terug naar Owell Rock om de moord op zijn vader te wreken. Om zijn plannen te kunnen uitvoeren, verandert hij zijn naam en laat hij een andere man zich voordoen als "Lawrence White."

programme.title: Boot Hill
programme.desc: Slachtoffers van de onderdrukkende stadsbaas Honey krijgen hulp aangeboden door een ongewone alliantie van schutters en circusartiesten.

programme.title: Outlaw Women
programme.desc: In deze unieke 50's western wordt een stad beheerd door vrouwen, waar mannen niet welkom zijn. Een vrouwelijke outlaw, onder de indruk van de medische vaardigheden van een jonge arts, dwingt hem naar de stad te reizen, die wordt gedomineerd door een corrupte gokhal. De stad komt in gevaar door een bende outlaws en de verkiezing van een nieuwe marshal, waar de vrouwen niet aan mee mogen doen.

programme.title: And Now... Make Your Peace with God
programme.desc: Twee mannen reizen naar Denver City om persoonlijke rekeningen te vereffenen: de een zoekt de moordenaar van zijn vader, de ander een vriend die zijn goud stal. Ze worden vergezeld door een mysterieuze scherpschutter. Samen begint een gevaarlijke jacht vol spanning en geheimen.

programme.title: The Southerner
programme.desc: Het leven van de arme familie Tucker, die werkte als katoenplukkers en besloot om hun eigen grond te krijgen, maar de natuur is tegen hen.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 40, 41, 42
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: Sartana wordt vals beschuldigd van een onmogelijke bankroof. Terwijl een premie op zijn hoofd staat, moet hij de echte daders vinden om zijn naam te zuiveren. Met hulp van zijn slimme, maar sjofele vriend Buddy Ben begint hij een gevaarlijke jacht op de waarheid. Kan hij zijn onschuld bewijzen voordat premiejagers hem te pakken krijgen?

programme.title: The Deadly Companions
programme.desc: Na per ongeluk de zoon van de cabaret danseres Kit Tilden te doden, probeert voormalig soldaat Yellowleg het goed te maken door haar begrafenisprocessie door gevaarlijk Apachegebied te escorteren. Samen met Billy en Turk moet hij Kit en de kist door vijandig land leiden om haar zoon te begraven bij haar overleden man.

programme.title: Django the Bastard
programme.desc: Een mysterieuze vreemdeling duikt op om wraak te nemen op voormalige Zuidelijke officieren die tijdens de Amerikaanse Burgeroorlog hun eigen eenheid verraadden, wat leidde tot een bloedige massaslachting. Zijn komst zaait angst terwijl hij hen één voor één confronteert met hun verleden.

programme.title: The Ruthless Four
programme.desc: In Nevada vinden goudzoeker Sam Cooper en zijn partner goud. Maar Sam's hebzuchtige partner begint te schieten op Sam die zijn toevlucht zoekt in de goudmijn.

programme.title: Life is Tough, Eh Providence
programme.desc: Een excentrieke premiejager genaamd Providence vangt en bevrijdt een crimineel om steeds weer dezelfde premie te innen in verschillende staten, totdat ze ontdekken dat een plaatselijke sheriff iets niet pluis is.

programme.title: And the Crows Will Dig Your Grave
programme.desc: Na de Burgeroorlog sluit Jeff Sullivan zich aan bij Wells Fargo om bandieten te bestrijden, gedreven door wraak op Glenn Kovacks, de moordenaar van zijn vrouw. Met hulp van Kovacks’ stiefbroer Dan en premiejager Pancho volgt hij het spoor. De jacht eindigt in een bloedige confrontatie waarbij Glenns bende wordt vernietigd en Dan ternauwernood gered.

programme.title: Only the Valiant
programme.desc: Kapitein Richard Lance wordt door zijn mannen en vriendin ten onrechte verantwoordelijk gehouden voor de dood van de geliefde Lt. Holloway door een indianenmoord. Holloway wordt gedood terwijl hij een gevaarlijk indianenopperhoofd begeleidt naar de gevangenis van een ander fort. Het opperhoofd ontsnapt. Wetende dat hun fort in gevaar is voor een Indiaanse aanval, neemt Lance een kleine groep buitenbeentjes mee naar een verlaten nabijgelegen legerfort om een bergpas te verdedigen tegen de naderende Indiaanse aanval. Hun missie is tijd rekken tot versterkingen uit een ander fort aankomen. De mannen in deze kleine groep van ontevredenen, deserteurs, psychopaten en lafaards haten kapitein Lance en wensen hem dood. Tot hun verdriet zien de mannen in dat Lance's overlevingsinstincten, militaire kennis en leiderschap de enige kans zijn voor de groep om in leven te blijven.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 48, 49
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: The Mercenary
programme.desc: Een inhalige Poolse huurling helpt een mijnwerker en een boerenmeisje bij het leiden van een revolutie tegen de onderdrukkende Mexicaanse regering, en wordt achtervolgd door een Amerikaanse rivaal.

programme.title: Four Rode Out
programme.desc: Een Amerikaanse marshal gaat op pad om een Mexicaanse bandiet op te pakken die beschuldigd wordt van de moord op de vader van zijn vriendin, maar er blijkt meer aan de hand te zijn dan op het eerste gezicht lijkt.

programme.title: Killer Caliber 32
programme.desc: Huurmoordenaar Silver doodt de zeven leden van een gemaskerde bende één voor één met behulp van zilveren kogels en zijn eigen code van gerechtigheid. Tussen pokerspelletjes en saloonmeisjes door leidt zijn missie tot de dramatische ontmaskering van de meedogenloze leider van de bende. Silver's stijl en eer maken hem tot een dodelijke kracht in dit verhaal vol actie.

programme.title: Buddy Goes West
programme.desc: Twee outlaws, “The Doctor” en de Indiaan Girolamo, helpen een dorp in de strijd tegen een bende en een corrupte sheriff die goud heeft ontdekt onder de stad.

programme.title: Crazy Westerners
programme.desc: Geïnspireerd door het leven van Hank Garland, is CRAZY het verhaal van een legendarische gitarist die in de jaren vijftig uit Nashville kwam.

programme.title: Santa Fe Trail
programme.desc: In 1854 worden Jeb Stuart, George Custer en andere afgestudeerden van West Point naar Kansas gestuurd om daar te helpen pacificeren voordat de aanleg van de spoorlijn naar Santa Fe kan worden hervat.

programme.title: Massacre
programme.desc: Een bende wapensmokkelaars wordt gezocht door zowel de Mexicaanse Rurales als de Yaqui-indianen. De Rurales willen voorkomen dat de indianen onschuldige boeren aanvallen, terwijl de indianen wraak willen nemen voor de valse medicijnen die hun kinderen blind maakten. De bende wordt gevangen, maar beiden worden omsingeld door de woedende indianen in een verlaten missie. Kunnen politie en criminelen samenwerken om te overleven?

programme.title: Lightning Jack
programme.desc: Lightning Jack Kane is een Australische outlaw in het wilde westen. Tijdens een mislukte bankoverval neemt hij de doofstomme Ben Doyle als gijzelaar. De twee worden goede vrienden en Jack leert Ben hoe hij banken moet beroven, terwijl ze Jacks laatste overval plannen.

programme.title: Guns Of The Revolution
programme.desc: In Mexico leidt een krankzinnige generaal zijn eigen oorlog tegen de kerk.

programme.title: Gentleman Killer
programme.desc: Een grensstad wordt meegesleurd in politieke onrust wanneer een Mexicaanse bandiet een bloedige campagne voert tegen Amerikaanse soldaten. Terwijl de spanningen tussen de VS en Mexico oplopen, dreigt de stad het toneel te worden van een explosief conflict.

programme.title: Day of Anger
programme.desc: Bankoverval uitgevoerd door de bank ambtenaren, niet de gebruikelijke James bende.

programme.title: New Frontier (1939)
programme.desc: De staatsregering is van plan een dam te bouwen om overstromingen tegen te gaan en veroordeelt de eigendommen van de plaatselijke boeren en ranchers, waaronder The Three Mesquiteers. De staat wil de landeigenaren een eerlijke compensatie geven, maar een oneerlijke vastgoedpromotor bemoeilijkt de zaak. De ranchers, geleid door Stony Brooke ('John Wayne' (q)), Tucson Smith ('Ray Corrigan') en Rusty Joslin (Raymond Hatton) vechten terug tegen zowel de wet als de oplichters.

programme.title: Against a Crooked Sky
programme.desc: Een eenzame schutter spoort de leden van een vogelvrije bende op die zijn vrienden hebben vermoord.

programme.title: Texas, Adios
programme.desc: Burt Sullivan verlaat zijn baan als sheriff om in Mexico wraak te zoeken op Cisco, de moordenaar van zijn vader. In een angstig dorp ontdekt hij een schokkend geheim en werkt hij samen met de bewoners om Cisco te stoppen en gerechtigheid te brengen.

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: Een ranchjongen krijgt een veulen cadeau en groeit op om van hem te houden, maar het veulen ontsnapt, met tragische gevolgen.

programme.title: Neath the Arizona Skies
programme.desc: Een cowboy begeleidt een klein meisje, wiens moeder haar de erfgenaam maakte van een te gelde gemaakt oliebedrijf, en moet haar beschermen tegen een outlaw terwijl ze op zoek gaan naar de vader van het meisje.

programme.title: The Black Bounty Hunter
programme.desc: Twee zwarte Kopgeldjagers komen aan in een stadje in het Westen op zoek naar een outlaw. Ze ontdekken dat er geen sheriff is en nemen die rol over, tot ongenoegen van de witte bevolking. Ze veroorzaken chaos, achtervolgen vrouwen en jagen op geld, terwijl ze wachten op het moment om hun man te vangen.

programme.title: Gunfighters Die Harder
programme.desc: Criminele bankiers plannen een verzekeringsfraude en huren een Mexicaanse bende in om het goud van de bank te stelen, maar ze betalen ook Lasky's bende om de Mexicanen te doden.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: Kapitein Tom Harvey, een undercover legeragent, onderzoekt de diefstal van goudzendingen en neemt een baan als adjunct-sheriff in een stad die geteisterd wordt door een spook. Het spook zou een verkeerd veroordeelde gokker zijn, die voor de diefstallen werd opgehangen. Harvey ontdekt het mysterie achter het spook.

programme.title: Bonanza Compilation Episodes 34, 35, 36
programme.desc: De Wild West-avonturen van Ben Cartwright en zijn zoons terwijl ze hun ranch in Nevada runnen en verdedigen terwijl ze de omringende gemeenschap helpen.

programme.title: Showdown At Williams Creek
programme.desc: Een Britse soldaat besluit naar de Amerikaanse grens te verhuizen en een nieuw leven te beginnen. Hij vindt de grens zwaar en worstelt met het klimaat, dieven en oplichters. Hij wordt beschuldigd van moord en berecht.

programme.title: $1,000 on the Black
programme.desc: Na 12 jaar keert Johnny terug naar het stadje waar zijn broer Sartana hem liet opdraaien voor moord en zijn geliefde afpakte. Sartana heerst nu als meedogenloze baas, beschermd door zijn moeder. Maar Johnny heeft zijn straf uitgezeten en komt met een doel.

programme.title: Stranger On Horseback
programme.desc: Circuitrechter Rick Thorne komt in Bannerman aan, waar alles in handen is van de rijke rancher Josiah Bannerman. Thorne ontdekt dat diens zoon, Tom, iemand heeft gedood zonder dat er iets tegen hem gedaan is. Thorne confronteert Tom en zet hem gevangen, wat leidt tot een gevaarlijke strijd om gerechtigheid.

programme.title: Yellow Hair and the Fortress of Gold
programme.desc: De vurige blonde halfbloed Yellow Hair en haar gemakkelijke sidekick de Pecos Kid zitten achter een fortuin aan Mayagoud aan.

programme.title: Django, Prepare a Coffin
programme.desc: Een revolverheld vormt een bende van "overleden" executieslachtoffers om wraak te nemen op de politicus en outlaw die zijn vrouw heeft vermoord.

programme.title: Alien Thunder
programme.desc: Dit is het tragische verhaal van de voortvluchtige Almighty Voice (Gordon Tootoosis) uit Saskatchewan, een Cree-indiaan die uit wanhopige honger wordt gearresteerd voor het stelen van overheidsvee.

programme.title: Panhandle
programme.desc: John Sands, voormalig Texas-marshal, wordt een huurmoordenaar nadat hij ontdekt dat casino-eigenaar Matt Garson verantwoordelijk is voor de moord op zijn broer, Billy Sands, een krantenschrijver. Hij reist naar Texas om gerechtigheid te zoeken, ondanks de prijs op zijn hoofd.

programme.title: Griddle Nation
programme.desc: Spice lovers rejoice as the griddle ignites with bold flavor. From smoky peppers to bright heat and layered seasoning, this exploration celebrates the art of balancing fire and flavor. Home cooks experiment with spice to create dishes that bring warmth and excitement to every bite.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Up the Dish host Micah Trainor tries her hand at an Italian original - Veal Piccata! Lemony, buttery, capERS-y veal melts in the mouth after being pounded supERS-thin and seared to perfection. Poppy Sandler's sideways switch-up is a Caper Almond Crusted Halibut, sizzled and baked until gorgeously golden-brown and flaky, then garnished with chives and pea shoots. Next, Missy Hui goes Greek with her vegetarian Avgolemono, a silky-smooth citrusy soup starring lemon and egg, garnished with orzo and shimeji mushrooms. Tiera Singh ties it all together with her Sumac Veal Sweetbreads with a rough chopped caperberry-olive tapenade - browned veal sweetbreads are sprinkled with tart sumac and laid on a bed of tapenade, then drizzled with a sweet 'n' sour pomegranate molasses vinaigrette.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: First up on this episode of Up the Dish is Poppy Sandler's Borscht straight from the Eastern Bloc! A mix of roasted and simmered beets adds complexity to the creamy soup - and don't forget that vivid burgundy hue. Tiera Singh swaps soup for a sandwich with her Beet-Stained Trout Gravlax, pairing the eye-catching seafood with zesty lemon-dill cream cheese and rye pumpernickel bread. Next, Micah Trainor mixes up a vegetarian Roasted Beet Salad paired with crackly Seed Brittle and a simple sweet dressing; it's a crunchy, earthy delight! Missy Hui's three-layer Red Beet Velvet Cake is a true triple threat. Red beet puree gives this cake its vermillion colour - and pairing it with tangy goat cheese icing... well, it just makes sense!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: In this episode of Up the Dish, host Micah Trainor takes a stab at Cassoulet with buttery white beans, duck leg confit, and flavourful French sausage - and the result is mouth-wateringly good! The pressure's on, but Tiera Singh doesn't let up with her Chinese Long Bean Stir Fry. Succulent sausage, delicious duck breast, and flavorful vegetables come together for a truly sumptuous dish! For her vegetarian variant, Missy Hui must move things up a notch, but how? Agedashi Tofu! Breaded crispy semi-firm tofu is doused in a dashi, gochujang, and mirin mixture for the ultimate umami mouthful. Poppy Sandler goes above and beyond with her Chocolate-crusted Elk Loin, seared and drizzled with a decadent Coffee- Blueberry Demi-Glace - sound strange? Tastes terrific!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: How do you make any lasagna recipe better? Ask Tiera Singh to take it up, of course! Her 'Nonna-style' bechamel and Bolognese-based Lasagna is topped with melty mozzarella for a luscious and luxuriant dish. Tiera tosses it over to Poppy Sandler, whose sideways Seafood Lasagna mixes up mussels, shrimp, and a briny bechamel sauce - yum! Next, Micah Trainor makes a dressed-up vegetarian version of the classic - her Zucchini-Mushroom Lasagna Rolls with tangy sundried tomatoes, savoury ricotta cheese, and earthy mushroom duxelles is simply superlative. Missy Hui hits the sweet spot with her Chocolate Raspberry Dessert Lasagna; layers of rich white chocolate, thick raspberry coulis, and velvety mascarpone cheese come together for a dessert that's in the stratosphere!

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Host Poppy Sandler kicks off Up the Dish with her version of mom's spaghetti - a scrumptious Spaghetti Pomodoro that takes it to the top! Next up to the plate is Missy Hui, who hits it out of the park with her heavenly Bun Viet, a sweet and sour vermicelli noodle bowl and citrusy lemongrass grilled pork combo. Then, Tiera Singh takes up the challenge with her vegetarian Miso Ramen - an umami flavour bomb of miso, mirin, and even more noodle goodness. But there's nowhere to go but up with Micah's Lobster Cantonese Chow Mein, an elegantly upscaled rendition of Chinese noodles with bright ginger, tender gai lan, and crisp chow mein, all coated in an exquisite black bean sauce.

programme.title: Up the Dish
programme.desc: Get ready for a not-so-raw deal in this episode of Up the Dish! Host Poppy Sandler sets things in motion and slices up a simple, elegant Sashimi with tangy Ponzu and tart Wasabi Mayo on the side. Missy Hui gets carnivorous with Lamb Carpaccio and Dukkah - delicate raw lamb and a Middle Eastern-style dip served with some delicious pita! But wait, what's a vegetarian to do with all this meat? Tiera Singh's got the answer - island-style Poke Bowls, with fruit instead of fish. Refreshing watermelon is marinated in a savoury, soy-based sauce and served with rice. For the finale, Micah Trainor Up('s) the Dish with her Scallop Tartare and Beet Chips, combining raw scallops with ultra-decadent truffle oil and sour cream.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Renowned Chef Michael Bonacini takes viewers on a culinary tour of the Italian region of Trentino-Alto Adige without leaving his own kitchen.

programme.title: Bonacini's Italy
programme.desc: Charming host Chef Michael Bonacini explores the mountainous region of Basilicata with a feast fit for any celebration. Beginning with an antipasto that caters to the region's southern heat, Michael stuffs crunchy sweet peppers with ripe tomatoes, savoury anchovies, and fresh oregano. Moving on to the primo, Michael cooks up a creamy Vermicelli Frittata. Using leftover pasta, he combines eggs with cheese, anchovies, and chili flakes for extra flavour to make a classic Basilicata dish. Michael cooks up Pollo Alla Potentina, a traditional meal from the Feast of Saint Gerard. This hearty chicken stew is sure to heat up your core, using hot peppers as the base of the meal. For his final dish, Michael combines the rich tastes of pomegranate, walnuts, and dark chocolate to create his unique Sweet Wheat Bowl.

programme.desc: Seafood loving chef Spencer Watts gets casual and formal with monkfish and clam recipes that feature some of his favorite libations - beer and wine.

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.sub-title: S01 : E01 Classics with a Twist
programme.desc: When planning a multi-course dinner for six, we all think 'go with the classics' and so does sassy chef-host Kim Lallouz. For her, however, it's Classics... with a Twist! Use the One big Recipe and cook along as Bread and Butter gets a smoke, honey, herb, and black sea salt makeover. Next, Shrimp Cocktail is reinvented with a horseradish kick in her Apricot Ketchup. Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! For a sweet ending, dress up dessert from your favourite bakery with a cool trick for making easy lavender ice cream. Dinner is love, and you will love this dinner!

programme.title: One BIG Recipe
programme.desc: Spring is in the air for this multi-course dinner One Big Recipe with engaging Chef Kimberly Lallouz. First up, it's Scallop Crudo, and it's peachy! Literally! Lamb Shanks braised with olives and sun-dried tomatoes are next, as an appetizer ragout, lovingly stuffed into pillowy, perfect mini-Yorkshire Puddings. Next, verdant spears of asparagus appear, topped with creamy, crunchy, soft-cooked egg Sauce Gribiche. Halibut is the main event, pan-roasted steaks are served over king trumpet Dill Pesto Mushrooms and finished with many melty coins of punchy Pink Peppercorn Compound Butter. The entire dinner is laid out in the signature One Big Recipe format, easy to follow, easy to make and guaranteed to impress!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: For this "N" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas works with noodles and nectarines. For her first dish, Lauren cooks up a breaded nectarine and mozzarella stack. Talking technique, she shows us how to cut nectarines into rounds. She does the same with some soft mozzarella and then walks us through the art of a balsamic reduction. For the noodles, Chef Lauren puts an elegant twist on your childhood favourite with a lobster mac and cheese. She spares no flavours, adding fried bacon, garlic, cayenne pepper, mustard powder, and even dry vermouth. This is no ordinary noodle dish. But now for the real challenge! Chef Lauren works with the noodles and nectarines.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: Culinary expert Theresa Visintin picks the letter "B" and must combine beef with buttermilk for her challenge. But first, she works with the ingredients separately. Silky buttermilk lends itself perfectly to Theresa's battered blooming onion recipe. Using the biggest onion she can find, Theresa skillfully slices from the root down, ensuring it will bloom into a beautiful flower. She coats the Vidalia onion in egg, buttermilk and smoky spiced flour, before deep frying it. Next up, it's time for beef to get the Theresa treatment, as she prepares a crowd favourite- smoky, juicy, fall-off-thebone baked beef brisket. With the perfect balance of sweet and spicy, this meal will make you look forward to leftovers...if there are any! Now for the challenge - Theresa skillfully blends beef with buttermilk in a recipe that will tempt your taste buds.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: After picking "M" for this episode's challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas decides to make meal magic using maple and mahi-mahi. She starts by combining chestnut and quinoa to create a mouth-watering medley, rich in flavour and texture. Chef Lauren adds shiitake mushrooms and drizzles the dish with a balsamic vinegar, maple syrup and rosemary dressing. Next up, she steams Mahi-mahi with red chilies and lemongrass, this savoury spice is a heavenly combination with an invigorating aroma. For the challenge, Chef Lauren seamlessly introduces both maple and mahimahi into one flavourful fusion.

Then, it's Potato Pave as a standalone course, garnished with tangy tarragon crÃ¨me fraiche and briny salmon roe. Prime Rib is as classic as it comes, but with a sous-vide twist and truffle-spiked Pea and Lardon salad, plan to drop everything so you can twist along! programme.title: One BIG Recipe

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Travel the world without ever leaving the kitchen! Intrepid host of CombiNATION Plates, Bianca Osbourne, starts this episode with Ethiopian inspired Berbere Spiced Quail, seared in aromatic Niter Kibbeh, and served with crunchy-sour Gomen Salad. Brazil is next, check out this re- invention of Feijoada... with braised and seared pork belly, oranges, crema, and fresh black bean salsa. Common ingredient 'Coffee and Sweets' is next... with java-spiked Injera Crepe Cake for Ethiopia and Brazil blending up a dark roast of rich, coffee-spiked, chocolatey Brigadeiros truffles. The final plate is Coconut Crusted Black Cod with cheesy Brazilian-style Pao de Queijo bites, and teff flour a brush of spiced ghee inspired by Ethiopia.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Join CombiNATION Plates host Bianca Osbourne for a trip to Morocco and Thailand! First up, whole Red Snapper is rubbed with earthy Ras el Hanout spice, poached in argan oil, and served with char-grilled oranges. Thailand inspires the next plate; Chicken Thigh 'Lollipop', roasted and served with bamboo shoots, chilies, and sauced with peanut-coconut red curry. Next, these countries both love Spring Rolls... Morocco's version, Briouat, is stuffed with saffron couscous and fresh cheese and fried... from Thailand comes a salad roll with shrimp and mango, dipped in a fiery green Nam Jim. Stick around for the big dish - Saffron buttERS-basted beef Striploin, served with complex Apricot-Green Curry Chutney and sent spinning with never before seen Chermoula Grass Jelly!

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: CombiNATION Plates is television's best travel show that never leaves the kitchen. Skilled Chef Craig Wong is your host, and prepare to be blown away by his takes on the foods of France and Vietnam. First up? A re-write of a popular Vietnamese street snack made with Clams and Sesame Rice Noodles. Next? Marrow Toast dresses up in its tux and tails for a version made with King Oyster Mushrooms and Sauce Bordelaise. The common ingredient is Baguette; check out supersonic versions of French Jambon Beurre and Vietnamese Banh Mi. The Big Dish blends delicate sole with ProvencÌ§ale flavour spiked Nuoc Cham and a crunchy Haricot Amandine inspired Vietnamese crepe.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Go-to Indian menu item Lamb Rogan Josh is one thing, but Lamb Sweetbreads Rogan Josh with Aloo Gobi Foam? That's a CombiNATION Plates thing! Craig Wong is at it again in this USA + India episode. After India, Chef moves on to the USA to answer the question, 'is everything better battered and fried?' with his Country Fried Torchon of Foie Gras. The common ingredient for these two distant nations is lobster, and really, who doesn't love it? For the US, it's Lobster with Cajun Spice Grits and Pickled Okra, and for India, check out Lobster Curry with Coconut Milk. The finale features Catfish like you've never seen it. Cooked Tandoori style and served with Collard Greens Paneer and Peach Bhaji, it's a one-of-a-kind CombiNATION sensation!

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: Halibut is on the menu for Craig Wong's first stop in this episode of CombiNATION Plates for his Icelandic tribute, the firm, flaky fish is served with Lovage, BeÌarnaise, and Beet Glazed Turnips. Next, it's a Jamaican adventure on a plate featuring whole, soft-shell crab Escovitch, fried, doused in chili vinegar, and served with carrot meringue?! Check out the common ingredient: ice cream! With creamy Skyr style with Blueberries representing Iceland and an Avocado Lime sensation for Jamaica that only Chef Wong could pull off, made in mere moments with liquid nitrogen! The Big Dish is a you-could-only-find-it-here experience; Jamaican Jerk Spice Reindeer (yes, you read that right) served with Brown Stew Wild Mushrooms and Salsify.

programme.title: CombiNation Plates
programme.desc: If you are talking about Irish food, it's hard not to talk about Corned Beef and Cabbage. On this episode of CombiNATION Plates, Chef Craig Wong delivers his unusual take using Beef Cheek, modern technique, and a caraway-infused Carrot Terrine for fun! Next up is a tribute to Izakaya eats, featuring Tare Grilled Duck Hearts, Miso-roasted Mushroom, and Agedashi Tofu. The featured common ingredient is Oysters. For Ireland, it's Garlic GratineÌe; for Japan, check out the Kaki Yaki, oysters broiled with miso and rich Japanese Kewpie mayo. For the final dish, light up! Smoking is permitted! Check out blowtorch-seared and tableside-smoked Wagyu Beef, brushed with Irish Stout Teriyaki and served with Wasabi Champ Potato. Now that's a CombiNation Plate!

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: For this "N" challenge, Chef Lauren Gulyas works with noodles and nectarines. For her first dish, Lauren cooks up a breaded nectarine and mozzarella stack. Talking technique, she shows us how to cut nectarines into rounds. She does the same with some soft mozzarella and then walks us through the art of a balsamic reduction. For the noodles, Chef Lauren puts an elegant twist on your childhood favourite with a lobster mac and cheese. She spares no flavours, adding fried bacon, garlic, cayenne pepper, mustard powder, and even dry vermouth. This is no ordinary noodle dish. But now for the real challenge! Chef Lauren works with the noodles and nectarines.

programme.title: A is for Apple
programme.desc: In this episode, Chef Robert Jewell explores recipes using two very different ingredients that start with the letter "O," oats and okra. For his first dish, Robert uses okra in a classic cornmeal cake recipe, but bumps up the flavour factor with spicy jalapenos. Robert balances the heat of the jalapeno with a tart green tomato and crunchy red onion salsa. In his next recipe, Robert keeps the heat, but switches up his recipes for a curry-spiced oat pancake. This Indian inspired dish needs something to cool it down and Robert knows exactly what that is - sweet, silky applesauce! He's up for the challenge when it comes to combining okra and oats into one dish, and the results are tasty!

programme.title: A New Life in the Sun S1 - "Costa del Pub"
programme.desc: A couple battles delays opening a seafood restaurant in Spain. Londoners chase their B&B dream in rural France while a Costa del Sol pub gears up for summer crowds.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Fez, Morocco"
programme.desc: In Fez, Morocco, not much has changed since the Middle Ages but Rodney is determined to stir things up and find tantalizing new dishes he can bring home.

programme.title: The Delinquent Gourmet S1 - "Sardinia"
programme.desc: Rodney is in Sardinia, Italy, where he finds culinary inspiration around every corner. High in the Sardinian hills, his hosts prepare their specialty - roasted suckling pig. After sitting down to an outdoor family meal (where even the dog helps himself!), Rodney samples a myrtle-flavored liquor before dancing with his gentlemen hosts.

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Cyprus"
programme.desc: Cyprus is the island of love beauty and in this episode of Luxe Travels, Host Sophie Ashley traverses the beautiful Mediterranean island to find out all about the must see and must experience spots in the birth place of Aphrodite!

programme.title: Luxe Travels S1 - "Philippines"
programme.desc: This Luxe Travels episode explores one of Philippines 7000+ islands, and this particular island is voted by most travel publications to be the most beautiful in the world. We are of course talking about the island of Palawan.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Las Vegas"
programme.desc: Las Vegas is home to a hot rod car club community which over the decades has been connected to the rise of rockabilly music. Through Luke Metz and his band, Shanda & The Howlers, we learn how this bond between fashion, music and cars was created.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S1 - "British Columbia"
programme.desc: Michael visits BC for a canoe tour, joins a rescue team on a hovercraft, plays pond hockey, and takes his final train trip.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s newest and oldest railways"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E01 Riding America’s newest and oldest railways
programme.desc: Starting in Key West, Michael heads north to find the first tracks of his journey, riding the nation's newest and oldest railways.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s steepest and longest railways"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E02 Riding America’s steepest and longest railways
programme.desc: The quest for the northernmost station continues as Michael tackles the steepest grades and longest railway stretches in the country.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Nevada"
programme.desc: Lisa meets off-grid desert nomads turning to this lifestyle out of necessity rather than choice. Van Life rebels rule in Slab City, while in Nevada, Bob Wells - the godfather of Van Life - helps thousands turn to nomadic life when in dire straits.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Desert"
programme.desc: Lisa connects with a nomad poet, who literally helps her ‘climb’ out of her funk by scaling a challenging peak. After taking tea with a magician, Lisa meets a paramedic single mother hoping to imbue her daughter with valuable life experiences.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "California Coast"
programme.desc: After driving across the country, Lisa heads to Santa Monica to hang with a Hollywood producer and check out his pimped out Mercedes Benz G-Wagon. Lisa is welcomed into the school bus home of a family of 7! Because there is always room for one more.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Berlin"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx journeys Berlin, one of the worlds undisputed techno capitals, and discovers the sound of freedom buried in its history.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Ibiza"
programme.desc: DJ-producer Carly Foxx travels to the clubbing capital of the world to inspire her music track and discovers Ibiza’s alternative spiritual side.

programme.title: City Beats S1 - "Europe"
programme.desc: DJ and house music producer Carly Foxx looks back at her journey to the music dance capitals of Europe to inspire her final track.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "London"
programme.desc: James heads across the pond to discover what life for a blind traveler is like in a world capital like London.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "United Kingdom"
programme.desc: Escaping the hustle and bustle of the big city, James takes the train to visit the rest of England - proving the rest of England is more accessible than one might think.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: James returns to his former home city of Los Angeles, where he reconnects with old friends working in accessibility in the entertainment industry.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Oakland"
programme.desc: Yann celebrates Oakland's skateboarding culture's diversity. He visits Unity Skate Shop and Lower Grand Radio. He explores Town Park with K-Dub, meets Jai and the Skate Like a Girl crew. Then skate's Marbie's mini ramp, the hook and a dragon.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "LA County"
programme.desc: Yann explores LA County skateboard communities, visiting Gunter's handmade leather goods workshop, Open Gallery, Justin's recycled skateboard wood shop, Tito from Local Hearts Foundation, and Eunice a vlogger, emphasizing community and creativity.

programme.title: A Simple Path S3 - "Los Angeles"
programme.desc: Yann explores Los Angeles', visiting Kingswell Skate Shop, meeting DJ Chavez and Norman Woods. He encounters Di'Orr Greenwood's artistic skateboards, Hali Strada's fashion and Chandler Burton's unique project merging drag, puppets and skating.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s longest and most luxurious railways"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E03 Riding America’s longest and most luxurious railways
programme.desc: This leg of the trip combines the longest continuous rail journey in America with a stay on the country’s most luxurious train.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s highest altitude and most scenic railways"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E04 Riding America’s highest altitude and most scenic railways
programme.desc: Breathtaking views await on a historic steam train as the trek reaches its highest altitude while navigating a famously scenic route.

programme.title: DownieLive Travels By Train S2 - "Riding America’s longest ferry"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E05 Riding America’s longest ferry
programme.desc: A first-class railcar carries Michael toward the Grand Canyon before he boards the country's longest ferry ride to bridge the gap to the north.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "North Carolina"
programme.desc: Meet Lisa, a former lawyer who escaped the rat race and moved into a campervan after the early death of her mother. Lisa embarks on a cross-country road trip, peeking inside homes on wheels, and connecting with the incredible community of nomads.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Mississippi, Alabama & Arkansas"
programme.desc: A hurricane in the south forces Lisa to change direction. We meet southern Van Lifers living under the radar in a state where the lifestyle is judged harshly. Tragically, Lisa’s story takes a heavy turn when she discovers that her father has died.

programme.title: My Van Life S1 - "Texas"
programme.desc: A colourful graffiti artist in Austin shares her story of loss with Lisa and gives her a tarot reading. We travel to rural Texas to overnight with Jupiter: an outspoken, non-binary person of colour, living in their vintage RV while studying law.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Costa Rica"
programme.desc: Marilia explores Costa Rica, connecting with nature at Zunya, experiences a cacao ceremony with the Maleku Tribe, and finds wellness in Tamarindo's Cala Luna. At La Senda, she learns to appreciate nature's beauty and the importance of slowing down.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Ireland"
programme.desc: Marilia's Irish journey, meeting land enthusiasts, explored scenic spots, encounters with Ellie and Hazel, vegan delights at Cornucopia, and concluded with a reflective sunset in the Wicklow Mountains, highlighting a strong community spirit.

programme.title: Journey Within S1 - "Bali"
programme.desc: Marilia's Bali journey, focused on purification rituals, blended culture, healing, and adventure. From Tirta Empul's cleansing to exploring Ubud, embracing nature, and local traditions, she found serenity, capturing precious moments in her odyssey.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "NYC, USA"
programme.desc: Four BC One World Final legends from our series, Ronnie, Neguin, Junior and Shigekix, are coming to NYC. These legends will meet some of the future legends taking part in this year’s world final and take them on a journey through hip hop history.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Goma, Congo"
programme.desc: Bboy Junior is going back where he was born, The Democratic Republic of Congo. World champion Shigekix will join him, visiting Africa for the first time. Together they will explore the dance culture in the city of Goma.

programme.title: Breaking Beyond S1 - "Sao Paulo, Brazil"
programme.desc: Russian Bgirl Kastet is visiting Sao Paulo, the home of Bboy Neguin. Together they will explore the dance, breaking and hip hop culture in the streets of Sao Paulo. Meeting up with legends and learning Capoeira, Jiu Jitsu and Passinho.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "Seattle / Vancouver"
programme.desc: After a surprese invite to visit the head of accessibility at Microsoft's headquarters in Seattle, James heads to Vancouver, Canada's jewel of the Pacific Northwest.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "New York City"
programme.desc: How does the bustling island of steel and stone fare for those with disabilities? James sets out to discover what it's like to travel blind in the Big Apple.

programme.title: Blindspots S1 - "London"
programme.desc: James heads across the pond to discover what life for a blind traveler is like in a world capital like London.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "England and Wales: Castles, Baths, and Tubing"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E07 England and Wales: Castles, Baths, and Tubing
programme.desc: Cross the English Channel to a land of knights and castles. Tour London’s Big Ben on a double-decker bus and explore historic cathedrals and baths.

programme.title: The Coolest Places on Earth S1 - "Beaches, Castles, and the Happiest Place on Earth"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E08 Beaches, Castles, and the Happiest Place on Earth
programme.desc: Find happiness in the sun-drenched Florida Keys, trek through the rugged Scottish Highlands, and discover the stunning coastal waterfalls of Croatia.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "To Find a Home"
programme.sub-title: S01 : E04 To Find a Home
programme.desc: British couple Will & Grace start the search for a home in adventure capital Queenstown and city boy Ethan Tey faces the harsh realities of the Auckland housing market.

programme.title: House Hunt S1 - "Dream Homes"
programme.desc: Lovebirds Jess & Simon need help from their parents to buy a home on Auckland’s North Shore and Queenstown couple Will & Grace prepare to go to auction on their dream home.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "Italy"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey master Roman pasta and tripe while honoring their Māori heritage and fallen soldiers at the historic Monte Cassino battlegrounds.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "India"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey face a sensory explosion in Old Delhi's streets, feed thousands at a Sikh temple, and prep appetizers for a massive Indian wedding.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "Belgium"
programme.desc: In a country not renown for excitement, something huge is about to happen. Jonathan digs around the Flanders exploring western Europe's least appreciated region.

programme.title: Road Less Traveled S3 - "England"
programme.desc: Jonathan plunges into London for an urban adventure, exploring the subcultures of the diverse city. A trip that will include stripping for naked poetry, spraying bars with grime rappers, and viewing burlesque at it’s roots.

programme.title: Travel Quest S1 - "North Pole"
programme.desc: The crew takes an icebreaker to the North Pole just in time to make a satellite phone call to wish Bill's mother a happy birthday (she is so shocked she doesn't recognize him). We also track and film the biggest predators on earth…polar bears.

programme.title: The Streets S1 - "Miami"
programme.desc: James Lance gets to grips with his Colombian roots while trying to build a career as a Latin hip hop artist. After raising himself as a teenager, he refuses to give up and dreams of a better future.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Maldives / Soneva Jani"
programme.desc: At Soneva Jani, Sashi experiences ultra-luxury dining—from crab curry to surprise chef’s tables and sunset BBQs in the Maldives’ most iconic resort.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Mauritius Part 1"
programme.desc: Sashi explores Mauritius from street food to luxury resorts, tasting rum, meeting top chefs, and uncovering why this island is a rising global hotspot

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S4 - "Mauritius Part 2"
programme.desc: Sashi dives into Mauritius’ food scene—street eats, rum, top chefs, and luxury escapes—showing why this island is becoming a must-visit destination.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Jackfruit"
programme.desc: In Bali's lush landscapes, Lauren explores the tropical origin of jackfruit, partnering with a Balinese chef to unveil age-old recipes and techniques, showcasing how this versatile fruit reigns supreme in traditional and modern dishes.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Rice"
programme.desc: Delve into the world of rice with Lauren as she explores different varieties, shares tricks, and puts her own twist on unique rice-based dishes, blending local and western recipes to create flavorful meals like Balinese Nasi Goreng and Risotto.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Turmeric"
programme.desc: Journey alongside Lauren as she delves into the vibrant world of turmeric. From infusing it into dishes like Urap Pakis to crafting a healthful elixir called Jamu, discover the captivating flavors against the breathtaking backdrop of Mount Agung.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - "Sweetness Migration"
programme.desc: The program reveals the unique attraction of sweet food that allows it to transcend geographical boundaries to become a bond shared worldwide, a form of cultural expression, and a means of heritage prevention.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - "Sweet Inspiration"
programme.desc: This episode show how people draw inspiration from society to create food, thereby bringing a richer and more colorful dietary culture.

programme.title: Sweet Planet S1 - "Sweet Collisions"
programme.desc: This episode of "Sweet Collisions" focuses on the complexity and nuances brought about by the mixing and clashing of different flavors in the process of making sweets, including the interplay of sweet, sour and spicy tastes.

programme.title: Foodwise S2 - "Hainan's Four Famous Dishes"
programme.sub-title: S02 : E12 Hainan's Four Famous Dishes
programme.desc: The stunning east coast of Hainan in southeast China, attract numerous visitors to travel. Hainan’s four famous dishes are chicken, duck, goat and crab.

programme.title: Foodwise S3 - "Xishuangbanna Part 1"
programme.desc: From dazzling night markets to lush bamboo forests, 800 year old tea trees to close encounters with elephants, this tropical city in southwest China has everything, and is where the story of tea begins.

programme.title: Foodwise S3 - "Xishuangbanna Part 2"
programme.desc: Come get soaked at the Dai people's New Year celebrations! All this before hiking through an actual rainforest. We're going to need all the good tea and food we can get!

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "Vietnam"
programme.desc: Karena and Kasey hunt for Hanoi’s famous street food and meet a top chef in Hoi An to tackle their trickiest, most rewarding challenge yet.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "USA"
programme.desc: Cruising LA in a Mustang, Karena and Kasey explore food trucks and vegan trends before catering an ANZAC function for over 500 people.

programme.title: Karena and Kasey’s Foreign Flavours S1 - "China"
programme.desc: In Shanghai, Karena and Kasey meet a culinary idol and head to Nan Xiang to master soup dumplings before catering a spring lunch at NZ House.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S5 - "Thailand"
programme.desc: Sashi visits Bangkok's Klong Toei slums for jumping shrimp and dines at the world-class Riva del Fiume.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S5 - "Fiji/ Maldives"
programme.desc: Sashi experiences Fijian pit cooking and a kava ceremony before a private sandbank dinner in the Maldives.

programme.title: Maximum Foodie S5 - "Bali Part 1"
programme.desc: Sashi discovers Balinese street staples like Nasi Campur and masters the fabled Babi guling roasted pig.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Bangkok"
programme.desc: Jack dives into the chaotic, aromatic world of Thailand's street food capital to see who can balance the ultimate sweet and sour flavors.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Tallinn"
programme.desc: Jack travels to Estonia's historic capital, exploring Nordic-inspired cuisine and medieval cooking techniques with his mystery ingredients.

programme.title: Inside the Box with Jack Stein S1 - "Rotterdam"
programme.desc: In the Netherlands' modern port city, Jack tests local culinary innovators with a box packed full of unexpected global flavors.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Nut"
programme.desc: Join Lauren on a culinary adventure with various nuts as she discovers their potential beyond snacking and incorporates them into Italian and Balinese recipes like Cashew cheese, mouthwatering Cabonara and more delightful flavors.

programme.title: Paradise Kitchen Bali S1 - "Coconut"

programme.title: The Outlaw
programme.desc: Billy the Kid, Pat Garrett, and Doc Holliday ride again in Howard Hughes' epic 1943 western, but the character you'll remember most is sultry country vixen Rio McDonald. Hughes' nationwide search for an actress to play Rio resulted in the film debut of Jane Russell, whose natural assets were allegedly helped by a special bra designed by Hughes. When The Outlaw finally received a nationwide release in 1946, its success vindicated Hughes and made Russell a star. As for Hughes' infamous bra, Russell said in her 1988 memoir, I never wore it, and he never knew.

programme.title: Range War
programme.desc: William Boyd returns in the 25th of 66 Hopalong Cassidy adventures. This time Hopalong goes undercover to expose a group of ranchers who are interfering with the building of a new railroad. Also, look for Russell Hayden as Lucky Jenkins, and Britt Wood as Speedy McGinnis. It's a great, action-packed adventure from director Leslie Selander (Flight to Mars, Riders of the Range), and further proof that no one pushes Hoppy around and gets away with it!

programme.title: The Red Rope
programme.desc: Hired killers and Old West outlaws stand front and center in this riveting tale from Hollywoods Poverty Row. Bob Steele, one of the busiest stars in movie history (everything from the silent era to Republic Pictures to working with Clint Eastwood in Hang Em High) is here as Tom Shaw, the target of a bad mans desperation and hate. Steele appeared in more than 240 movies and television shows, but was never more impressive than in The Red Rope!

programme.title: Stagecoach to Denver
programme.desc: Ride the outlaws' highway! Allan Rocky Lane stars as Red Ryder, shootin' and fightin' his way to justice in this old slugfest from Republic Pictures. This time he's a stagecoach driver battling a crooked land commissioner and his cohorts, including a sheriff on the take. Robert Blake costars as Little Beaver!

programme.title: A Lust to Kill
programme.desc: An imprisoned outlaw escapes and goes on the hunt for his brothers murderers, who just happen to be members of the outlaws own gang. He and his beloved hit the trail, but are pursued by local law enforcement, who have their own plans for justice. Starring Don Megowan, Jim Davis, and Allison Hayes.

programme.title: Law of the Pampas
programme.desc: Murder below the Equator...and Hopalong Cassidy races to action in the heart of the wild Pampas country !Hoppy (William Boyd) and his pal Lucky (Russell Hayden) head to South America to look after a herd of cattle sold by Cassidy's boss to an Argentine rancher. Unfortunately, the scoundrel Ralph Merritt (Sidney Blackmer) wants the cattle, and he's not above hiring some dangerous characters to do his dirty work. It's a test of blazing guns...under a blazing sun! Can the boys of Bar 20 lay down the law in a lawless place like the Pampas? Can Hoppy and his gang succeed in what is truly a last frontier? Watch and see!

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Cisco and Pancho are falsely accused of robbing a stagecoach. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt, and was nominated for a Primetime Emmy in 1951. This episode aired in 1951.

programme.title: Cisco Kid
programme.desc: Two bandits impersonate Cisco and Pancho, sending the two to prison for robbery and murder. Starring Duncan Renaldo as The Cisco Kid, and Leo Carillo as Pancho. This weekly adventure series was a favorite of the 1950s, following two pals as they traveled the old west, righting wrongs and helping the underdog. The show was nominated for a PrimeTime Emmy Award in 1951. It was produced by ZIV Television, the same company that gave us Highway Patrol and Sea Hunt. This episode aired in 1950.
